title: [2.7] Minor bug, DANA RS: "Pump Site Change" always logged with "Insulin Cartridge Change"
body:
Hi,

sometimes I change the insulin cartridge, but not the canula.

When logging the event using the Prime/Fill action, I tick "Insulin Cartridge Change" only (do NOT tick "Pump Site Change"), but nevertheless also a "Pump Site Change" is logged.

To my mind this is not correct and a "Insulin Cartridge Change" should be logged only.

could you have a look?

thank you,
Arne

comments.body:
Do you have an Insight pump?
There is a little bug in Insight driver, when you change cartridge, a site change is recorded in AAPS even if you don't prime canula in pump.
A workaround is to disable "Log site change" in Insight preference, but it's necessary after that to always manualy record site change in AAPS even if done directly in pump...

Philoul, I have Insight v2 but when I change cartridge, AAPS automatically records "Insulin Cartridge Change" but not "Pump site Change". In Insight Preferences I have disabled "Log tube changes" but not "Log site changes". However, I never prime canulla in pump but use AAPS button.

Hi,

No. Dana RS

/Arne
